renderer: deterministic p5.js Canvas 2D compressed pigment clasp
primitiveBudget: 9 generated pigment panels, 8 produced seams, 4 negative openings, one clasp tension field
commitThreshold: two opposed outer-jaw compressions released beyond the inner band
memoryRule: one jaw remains geometry-neutral; completed opposition changes remote panel geometry, seam tension, and an old opening; four compressions persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch compresses left and right jaws in turn; ArrowLeft then ArrowRight plus Enter uses the same relation; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: raster cure plate, monolithic witness body, and horizontal strata -> one generated pigment clasp organized around a load-bearing absence
compositionRupture: bounded grid, vertical body, and layered field -> asymmetric closed form with a dark inner absence and opposed outer jaws
encounterRupture: timed dwell, sequential witness exchange, and one-way traverse -> two-stage opposing compression that cannot commit alone
temporalRupture: duration threshold, latent call/reply, and release after crossing -> pressure is relational and only exists when both sides close
mediumRupture: Canvas raster cells, monolithic body, and horizontal strata -> generated polygon panels, seam curves, negative openings, and produced crease geometry
changedRule: A single jaw remains geometry-neutral. Only opposed compression from both outer jaws can spend pressure as a remote crease that opens an existing absence and bends the clasp's seams.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a generated nine-panel clasp around a dark absence. A valid two-sided compression leaves both jaw sites unpainted while changing remote panel vertices, seam bends, opening geometry, and crease depth; four compressions compound.
falsifier: Delete if one-sided input changes geometry, if the hand path becomes pigment, if handles answer themselves, if remote change is only colour/readout, if the blind form reads as radial ornament, or if later compressions reset.
deletionCondition: Delete v045 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the opposing clasp from v042-v044 or if opposition is only a label rather than a geometry-producing rule.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
